test_title: PYST 48 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. The research team recruited a large group of qualified participants for the study.

Q. At the end of the trial, they analysed the results to determine the drug's effectiveness.

R. The team monitored the health and progress of all the participants for several months.

S. Half the participants received the new drug, while the other half received a placebo.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. P, S, R, Q .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct arrangement is **P, S, R, Q**, which creates a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph.
 
• **P:** The research team recruited a large group of qualified participants for the study. (This introduces the study and its participants.)
 
• **S:** Half the participants received the new drug, while the other half received a placebo. (This explains how the study was conducted.)
 
• **R:** The team monitored the health and progress of all the participants for several months. (This describes the monitoring process during the study.)
 
• **Q:** At the end of the trial, they analysed the results to determine the drug's effectiveness. (This concludes the study with the analysis of results.)

Correct sentence: *The research team recruited a large group of qualified participants for the study. Half the participants received the new drug, while the other half received a placebo. The team monitored the health and progress of all the participants for several months. At the end of the trial, they analysed the results to determine the drug's effectiveness.*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **How to approach sentence rearrangement:**
 
 
• Identify the introductory sentence that sets the context.
 
• Follow the logical sequence of actions or events described.
 
• Conclude with a sentence that wraps up or provides results/outcomes.
 
 
 
• In this case, the sequence follows the steps of a research study: recruitment, conducting the trial, monitoring progress, and analysing results.
